scientific_integrity: The proof uses classical Weil theory and finite-group character decompositions. The original authors established the one-point classification and model; those prior contributions and geometric supersingularity are not claimed anew. No independent scientific validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform Hasse--Weil result is proved for the unique one-point Hermitian-relative class, not for other equivalence classes. Finite computations cover only listed small fields. A related 2026 equivalence-classification chapter was available only as an abstract; older general twist formulas may exist outside the searched sources.
title: The complete zeta function of the one-point Hermitian-relative curve
